technical.title: GroundingPI is a 4B Foundation Model for Precise Physical Intelligence
technical.summary: GroundingPI is a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates to tackle failures in vision-language-action and world-action models for closed-loop control.
technical.why: It directly improves precise visual grounding and tiny-object detection needed for autonomous driving and robotics control.

technical.title: SPLATIFY Automatically Converts 3DGS Papers into Trainable Code
technical.summary: SPLATIFY is a multi-agent framework that uses a context-free grammar and modular templates to convert 3D Gaussian Splatting papers into trainable gsplat-based implementations automatically.
technical.why: It streamlines computer vision research by accelerating the implementation and reproduction of novel 3DGS papers.

technical.title: vLLM Semantic Router Releases Decision 3.0 Multimodal Decision Models
technical.summary: vLLM Semantic Router launched Decision 3.0, consisting of five open multimodal decision models ranging from 0.8B to 27B parameters that answer choice and score questions without text generation.
technical.why: These models enable ultra-fast semantic routing and decision-making without the overhead of full text generation.

technical.title: Sakana AI Introduces Multi-Layered Review System for LLM Peer Review
technical.summary: Sakana AI introduced a 3-agent Claude-based Multi-Layered Review system that successfully caught 73.43% of core-claim errors across a 1,164-error contradiction benchmark.
technical.why: Automated peer review tooling helps researchers rapidly catch critical errors in complex AI papers.

technical.title: Alibaba Introduces QwenGyre for Elastic Reinforcement Learning in Agents
technical.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team unveiled QwenGyre, an online elastic reinforcement learning framework designed to train extreme-long-horizon agents on rollouts running for hours processing nearly 1M tokens.
technical.why: It offers a scalable approach for training complex, long-horizon AI agents using unmodified black-box harnesses.

technical.title: Deploy Multi-Node LLM Inference Workloads Using Ray Containers on EKS
technical.summary: This guide details how to deploy a single large language model across two GPU nodes on Amazon EKS using multi-node Ray LLM Deep Learning Containers with separate prefill and decode nodes.
technical.why: It provides a practical infrastructure blueprint for scaling high-performance LLM inference pipelines.

technical.title: ReplaySSM Rethinks State Storage for Faster Hybrid-Model Decoding
technical.summary: A short preview introducing ReplaySSM, which addresses state storage strategies for faster decoding in hybrid models interleaving state-space model layers with attention layers.
technical.why: State-space model optimizations are increasingly critical for efficient deployment of modern hybrid architectures.

technical.title: Deploy Decision Models with llama.cpp on Amazon SageMaker AI
technical.summary: A technical tutorial explaining how to serve OpenAI-compatible chat completions using the llama.cpp AWS Deep Learning Container and extend runtimes to return option probabilities.
technical.why: It demonstrates how to deploy open decision models efficiently for production scoring tasks on SageMaker.

technical.title: AgentSWE Benchmark Tests Coding Agents Across Three Development Stages
technical.summary: AgentSWE is a new benchmark featuring 25 tasks designed to evaluate coding agents across creation, editing, and optimization stages of the agent development lifecycle.
technical.why: It provides a rigorous way to test whether custom software engineering agents genuinely fulfill their natural-language requirements.

technical.title: Access OpenAI Models on Amazon Bedrock with Global Cross-Region Inference
technical.summary: A technical guide on running OpenAI GPT models on Amazon Bedrock using global cross-Region inference from locations like Singapore, Jakarta, and Taiwan, covering APIs and permissions.
technical.why: It helps engineers integrate frontier models regionally with compliant IAM permissions and managed API structures.

business.title: Microsoft to rely more on homegrown AI chips
business.summary: By increasingly counting on its own chips, Microsoft stands to expand margins and bolster its AI stack, reducing its dependence on Nvidia.
business.why: Shifting hardware supply chains directly impact infrastructure costs and hardware availability for large-scale AI deployment.

business.title: Microsoft announces third-generation Maia in-house AI chip
business.summary: Microsoft announced its third-generation Maia in-house AI chip, designed to serve as the primary AI inference system for its products and services while improving cloud workload efficiency.
business.why: In-house silicon development by major cloud providers alters the hardware market dynamics for AI inference and workloads.

business.title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
business.summary: Microsoft president Brad Smith calls for urgent AI regulation, saying milk and washing machines have more oversight than AI companies.

business.title: Jim Cramer says the bull market's remarkable 4-year run offers a crucial lesson for investors
business.summary: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said the market’s incredible four-year run shows why investors should stay invested rather than trying to time the market.

business.title: Russia was not ready for the data center war it started with Ukraine
business.summary: Russian bloggers warn Russia’s hyper-centralized digital economy is vulnerable.

business.title: Anthropic is cutting off its internal evaluations from the internet
business.summary: After a recent spate of high-profile incidents in which AI agents escaped containment, Anthropic is cutting off internet access for all internal evaluations. In a report Friday, the company detailed "unintended model act

business.title: Epic Games reportedly pivoting to "AI first" game development model
business.summary: "No more hand-written code" or AI-free art for delayed Marvel/Star Wars shooter.

models.title: Google DeepMind Launches Multimodal EmbeddingGemma 2 Model
models.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open multimodal embedding model that maps text, code, images, video, and audio into a unified 768-dimensional vector space. Designed for consumer hardware, it has 740M total parameters for low-latency on-device applications.
models.why: Provides efficient on-device multimodal embeddings for search and retrieval applications.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo Accelerates Generation With Eight Steps
models.summary: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is an accelerated 7B text-to-image and editing checkpoint that generates images using only 8 denoising steps. It features prefix KV caching and loads directly within Diffusers.
models.why: Speeds up image generation pipelines for computer vision engineers.

models.title: Cloudflare Releases Clef 27B Multimodal Decision Model
models.summary: Clef is a 27B multimodal model post-trained from Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B that processes text, JSON, images, or video states and outputs probabilities for typed questions in a single forward pass without free-form text generation.
models.why: Introduces a non-autoregressive approach for multimodal decision-making tasks.

models.title: Qwen3.8-27B Model Weights and Configurations Released
models.summary: The official Hugging Face Transformers-compatible weights and configurations for Qwen3.8-27B have been released. They support deployment via vLLM, SGLang, and TokenSpeed, with a managed API service upcoming.
models.why: Provides access to a foundational 27B model backbone for downstream fine-tuning and inference.

models.title: LiquidAI Releases d1-3B Decision Model
models.summary: d1-3B is a 3B parameter decision model built on LFM2.5-VL-3B that processes mixed multimodal states and questions into calibrated answers in one forward pass with zero output tokens, running at high speed.
models.why: Delivers fast, high-performing multimodal decision-making on consumer and edge hardware.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1 Uncensored Quantized Formats Released
models.summary: Quantized GGUF, Safetensors, and MLX formats of Qwen-Image-2.1 are now available for local image generation using ComfyUI. These include recommended files like Q4_K_M for balancing size and quality.
models.why: Enables local execution of Qwen image models across various hardware setups.
